turns.prompt: The two files hold smoothed 2H NMR acyl chain order parameters S_CD of POPC (sn-1 chain, carbon number n, comma-separated, no header) at 303 K: pure POPC and POPC with 10 mol% ibuprofen. Compute ΔS = S(with drug) − S(pure) per carbon (key 'delta_S', keyed by carbon number as a string), the mean ΔS over the plateau region C2 to C8 ('plateau_mean_delta'), and plot both order profiles against carbon number.
